facts.text: Under the Western Undergraduate Exchange (WUE), eligible undergraduate students from participating western states are billed at 150% of resident tuition for up to four academic years (8 semesters).

sources.title: Scholarships for Continuing MSUN Students | MSU Northern
sources.quote: WUE award recipients will be billed at a tuition rate which is only 150% of the resident tuition. New freshmen may retain their WUE Award (which is a tuition rate) for up to four academic years (8 semesters).
